summary: Statutory bail under Section 167(2) Cr.PC; presence of accused during extension of investigation period mandatory per Hitendra Vishnu Thakur and Sanjay Dutt; first extension granted ex parte on 22.04.2022 invalid; accused informed on 23.04.2022 but right to bail arose upon 90-day expiry; failure to challenge extension not waiver; Jigar Adatiya reaffirms procedural safeguard; retrospective validation impermissible per Sayed Mohd. Ahmed Kazmi; prosecution reliance on Rambeer Shokeen and Narender Goel distinguished; default bail indefeasible upon procedural lapse.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; appellant entitled to statutory bail; impugned judgment set aside.
